segments.transliteration: wa min shar-ri kul-li daaab-batin anta aaakhid'um-binaas'eeatihaa
segments.translation: 35.and the evil of "every crawling creature that You hast taken by the forelock!

segments.transliteration: in-naka a'laa s'iraat'im-mus-taqeem
segments.translation: 36.Surely You art on a straight path"(ref.11:56).

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih
segments.translation: 37.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ أَرَادَنِي بِسُوء فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَادْحَرْ عَنِّي مَكْرَهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa man araadanee bisooo-in  faas'-rif-hoo a'n-nee wa ad-h'ar a'n-nee mak-rah
segments.translation: 38.and if someone desires ill for me turn him away from me, drive away from me his deception,

segments.arabic: وَادْرَأ عَنِّي شَرَّهُ، وَرُدَّ كَيْدَهُ فِي نَحْرِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa ad-raa a'n-nee shar-rah wa rud-da kay-dahoo fee nah'-rih
segments.translation: 39.avert from me his evil, send his trickery back to his own throat,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ سَدّاً حَتَّى تُعْمِيَ عَنِّي بَصَرَهُ،
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l bay-na yaday-hee sad-dana h'at-taa tua'-meea a'n-nee bas'arah
segments.translation: 40.and place before him a barricade, so that You mayest blind his eyes toward me,

segments.arabic: وَتُصِمَّ عَنْ ذِكْري سَمْعَهُ، وَتُقْفِلَ دُونَ إخْطَارِي قَلْبَهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa tus'im-ma a'n d'ik-ree sam-a'h wa tuq-fila doona ikh-t'aaree qal-bah
segments.translation: 41.deafen his ears toward my mention, lock his heart toward recalling me,

segments.transliteration: wa tukh-risa a'n-nee lisaanah wa taq-maa' raa-sah
segments.translation: 42.silence his tongue against me, restrain his head,

segments.transliteration: wa tud'il-la i'z-zah wa tak-sira jabarootah
segments.translation: 43.abase his exaltation, break his arrogance,

segments.transliteration: wa tud'il-la raqabatah wa taf-sakha kib-rah
segments.translation: 44.abase his neck, disjoint his pride,

segments.transliteration: wa too-minanee min jameei' z''ar-rihee
segments.translation: 45.and make me secure from all his injury,

segments.transliteration: washar-rih wa gham-zihee wa ham-zihee wa lam-zih wa h'asadihee
segments.translation: 46.his evil, his slander, his backbiting, his faultfinding, his envy,

segments.transliteration: wa a'daawatih wa h'abaaa-ilihee wa mas'aaa-idih wa raj-lihee wakhay-lih
segments.translation: 47.his enmity, his snares, his traps, his foot soldiers, and his cavalry!

segments.transliteration: in-naka a'zeezun qadeer
segments.translation: 48.Surely You art Mighty, Powerful!

segments.translation: glory be to the compassionate, the merciful.

segments.arabic: اَللّـهُمَّ اْجَعلْ لي في قَلْبى نُوراً وَبَصَراً وَفَهْماً وَعِلْماً اِنَّكَ عَلى كُلِّ شَي قَديرٌ .

segments.translation: o Allah fill my heart and mind with true enlightenment, discerning intelligence, quick understanding and knowledge, Verily Thou art able to do all things.

segments.arabic: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَ هَا أُذُنٌ وَاعِيَة

segments.translation: Q 69:12 That We might make it for you a reminder and that receptive ears might remember it.

segments.transliteration: allaahummar-h'amnee bitarkil ma-a'as'ee abdan maa abqaytanee far-h'amnee min takallufi maa laa yuneenee warzuqnee h'usnal manz'ari feemaa yurz'eeka a'nnee wal-zam qalbee h'ifz'a kitaabika kamaa a'llamtanee warzuqnee an atluwahoo a'lan nah'wil lad'ee yurz'eeka a'nnee allaahumma nawwir bas'aree wash-rah bihee s'adre wa farru bihee qalbee wa at'liq bihee lisaaanee was-ta-mil bihee badanee wa qawwinee a'laa d'aalika wa a-i'nnee a'layhi innahoo laa mu-e'ena a'layhi illaa anta laa ilaaha illaa anta
segments.translation: I beseech You, O He who reminds about doing good, does good and commands to do good. Send blessings on Muhammed and the family of Muhammed and let me remember what shaytan makes me forget.

O Allah have mercy on me to be able to leave disobeying you till I am
alive. Show mercy on me by not imposing a troublesome and difficult
task on me. Make me do good deeds that please you. Make me learn your
book by heart, just like you have taught me. Give me the ability to
recite it in a manner that pleases you. O Allah (through the quran)
enlighten my wisdom, open the doors of understanding and liberate my
heart. Loosen my tongue, let my body be active and give me strength
for it. No one can help me save you. There is no god except you.

segments.transliteration: Waá¹£rif âannÄ adhÄhÄ wa maá¸arratahÄ,
segments.translation: And turn away from us their harm and damage,

segments.transliteration: WalÄ tuá¹£ibnÄ fÄ«hÄ biâÄfah,

segments.transliteration: WalÄ tursil âalÄ maâÄyishinÄ âÄhah,
segments.translation: And do not send blight upon our livelihoods.

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنْ كُنْتَ بَعَثْتَهَا نِقْمَةً وَأَرْسَلْتَهَا سَخْطَةً
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma wa in kunta baâathtahÄ niqmah wa arsaltahÄ sakhta,
segments.translation: O Allah, if You have sent them as a punishment and anger,

segments.transliteration: Fa innÄ nastajÄ«ruka min ghaá¸abika,

segments.transliteration: Wa nabtahilu ilayka fÄ« suâÄli âafwika,

segments.transliteration: Famul bilghaá¸abi ilÄ al-mushrikÄ«n,

segments.transliteration: Wa adir raá¸¥Ä niqmatika âalÄ al-mulá¸¥idÄ«n,

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma adhhib maá¸¥la bilÄdinÄ bisuqyÄk,
segments.translation: O Allah, remove the drought of our land with Your rain,

segments.transliteration: Wa akhrij waá¸¥ara á¹£udÅ«rinÄ birizqik,
segments.translation: And bring out the burning of our hearts with Your provision,

segments.transliteration: WalÄ tashghalnÄ âanka bighayrik,
segments.translation: And do not distract us from You with anything else,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَقْطَعْ عَنْ كَافَّتِنَا مَادَّةَ بِرِّكَ،
segments.transliteration: WalÄ taqá¹­aâ âan kÄffatinÄ mÄddata birrik,
segments.translation: And do not cut off from us the flow of Your goodness,

segments.transliteration: Fa innal-ghaniyya man aghnayt,
segments.translation: For the truly rich is the one whom You enrich,

segments.transliteration: Wa inna as-sÄlima man waqayt,
segments.translation: And the safe one is the one You protect,

segments.transliteration: MÄ âinda aá¸¥adin dÅ«naka difÄâ,
segments.translation: No one besides You has defense,

segments.transliteration: WalÄ biâaá¸¥adin âan saá¹­watika imtinÄâ,
segments.translation: And no one can resist Your might,

segments.arabic: تَحْكُمُ بِمَا شِئْتَ عَلَى مَنْ شِئْتَ،
segments.transliteration: Taá¸¥kumu bimÄ shiâta âalÄ man shiâta,
segments.translation: You judge as You will over whom You will,

segments.transliteration: Wataqá¸Ä« bimÄ aradta fÄ« man aradta,
segments.translation: And You decree as You wish upon whom You wish.

segments.arabic: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا وَقَيْتَنَا مِنَ الْبَلاءِ،
segments.transliteration: Falaka al-á¸¥amdu âalÄ mÄ waqaytanÄ minal-balÄâ,
segments.translation: So praise is Yours for protecting us from affliction,

segments.arabic: وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ عَلَى مَا خَوَّلْتَنَا مِنَ النِّعْمَاءِ
segments.transliteration: Walaka ash-shukru âalÄ mÄ khawwaltanÄ minan-niâmÄâ,

segments.transliteration: á¸¤amdan yukhallifu á¸¥amda al-á¸¥ÄmidÄ«na warÄâahu,
segments.translation: A praise that surpasses the praise of those who praise,

segments.transliteration: á¸¤amdan yamlaâu ará¸ahu wa samÄâahu,
segments.translation: A praise that fills His earth and His heaven,

segments.transliteration: Innakal-mannÄnu bijasÄ«mil-minan,
segments.translation: Surely, You are the Bestower of immense favors,

segments.transliteration: Al-WahhÄbu liâaáºÄ«min-niâam,
segments.translation: The Giver of great blessings,

segments.transliteration: Al-qÄbilu yasÄ«ra al-á¸¥amd,
segments.translation: The Accepter of even little praise,

segments.transliteration: Ash-shÄkiru qalÄ«la ash-shukr,
segments.translation: The Thankful for even little gratitude,

segments.transliteration: Al-muá¸¥sinu al-mujmilu dhÅ« aá¹­-á¹­awl,
segments.translation: The Beneficent, the Generous, the Possessor of bounty,

segments.arabic: لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ إلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ.
segments.transliteration: LÄ ilÄha illÄ anta ilayka al-maá¹£Ä«r,
segments.translation: There is no god but You; to You is the return.

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّ هذَيْن آيَتَانِ مِنْ آياتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-na hd'ay-ni aaayataani min aaayaatik
segments.translation: 1.O God, these are two of Your signs

segments.transliteration: wa hd'ay-ni a'w-naani min aa'-waanik
segments.translation: 2.and these are two of Your helpers.

segments.arabic: يَبْتَدِرَانِ طَاعَتَكَ بِرَحْمَة نَافِعَة أَوْ نَقِمَة ضَارَّة،
segments.transliteration: yab-tadiraani t'aaa'taka birah'-matin-naafia'tin aw naqimatin z''aaar-rah
segments.translation: 3.They rush to obey You with beneficial mercy or injurious vengeance,

segments.transliteration: falaa tum-t'ir-naa bihimaa mat'aras-saw
segments.translation: 4.so rain not down upon us from them the evil rain

segments.transliteration: wa laa tul-bis-naa bihimaa libaasal-balaaa
segments.translation: 5.and clothe us not through them in the garment of affliction!

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih
segments.translation: 6.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْزِلْ عَلَيْنَا نَفْعَ هَذِهِ السَّحَائِبِ وَبَرَكَتَهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa anzil a'lay-naa naf-a' had'ihs-sah'aaa-ibi wa barakatahaa
segments.translation: 7.send down upon us the benefit of these clouds and their blessing,

segments.transliteration: was'-rif a'n-naaa ad'aahaa wamaz''ar-ratahaa
segments.translation: 8.turn away from us their harm and their injury,

segments.transliteration: wa laa tus'ib-naa feehaa biaafah
segments.translation: 9.strike us not through them with blight,

segments.transliteration: wa laa tur-sil a'laa maa'ayishinaa a'ahah
segments.translation: 10.and loose not upon our livelihoods any bane!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنْ كُنْتَ بَعَثْتَهَا نَقِمَةً وَأَرْسَلْتَهَا سَخْطَةً
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa in kunta baa'th-tahaa naqimah wa ar-sal-tahaa sakh-t'ah
segments.translation: 11.O God, if You hast incited them as vengeance and loosed them in anger,

segments.transliteration: fa in-naa nas-tajeeruka min ghaz''abik
segments.translation: 12.we seek sanctuary with You from Your wrath

segments.transliteration: wa nab-tahilu ilay-ka fee soo-aali a'f-wik
segments.translation: 13.and implore You in asking Your pardon!

segments.transliteration: famil bil-ghaz''abi ilaal-mush-rikeen
segments.translation: 14.So incline with wrath toward the idolaters

segments.transliteration: wa adir rah'aa naqimatika a'laal-mul-h'ideen
segments.translation: 15.and set the millstone of Your vengeance turning upon the heretics

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma ad'-hib mah'-la bilaadinaa bisuq-yaak
segments.translation: 16.O God, take away the barrenness of our lands with Your watering,

segments.transliteration: wa akh-rij wah'ara s'udoorinaa biriz-qik
segments.translation: 17.dislodge the malice from our breasts with Your providing,

segments.transliteration: wa laa tash-ghal-naa a'nka bighay-rik
segments.translation: 18.distract us not from You through other than You,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَقْطَعْ عَنْ كَافَّتِنَا مَادَّةَ بِرِّكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa taq-t'aa' a'n kaaaf-fatinaa maaad-data bir-rik
segments.translation: 19.and cut none of us off from the stuff of Your goodness,

segments.transliteration: fa in-nal-ghanee-ya man agh-nay-t
segments.translation: 20.for the rich is he to whom You hast given riches,

segments.transliteration: wa in-nas-saalima maw-waqay-t
segments.translation: 21.and the safe he whom You hast protected!

segments.transliteration: maa i'nda ah'adin doonaka difaaa'
segments.translation: 22.No one has any defense against You,

segments.transliteration: wa laa bih'adin a'n sat'-watika am-tinaaa'
segments.translation: 23.nor any means to bar Your penalty.

segments.arabic: تَحْكُمُ بِمَا شِئْتَ عَلَى مَنْ شِئْتَ،
segments.transliteration: tah'-kumu bimaa shi-ta a'laa man shi-t
segments.translation: 24.You decidest what You wilt for whom You wilt

segments.transliteration: wa taq-z''ee bimaaa arat-ta fee man arat-t
segments.translation: 25.and You decreest what You desirest for any whom You desirest!

segments.arabic: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا وَقَيْتَنَا مِنَ الْبَلاءِ،
segments.transliteration: falakal-h'am-du a'laa maa waqay-tanaa minal-balaaa
segments.translation: 26.So to You belongs praise for protecting us from affliction

segments.arabic: وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ عَلَى مَا خَوَّلْتَنَا مِنَ النّعْمَاءِ
segments.transliteration: wa lakash-shuk-ru a'laa maa khaw-wal-tanaa minan-naa'-maaa-i
segments.translation: 27.and to You belongs thanks for conferring upon us blessings,

segments.transliteration: h'am-day-yukhal-lifu h'am-dal-h'aamideena waraaa-ah
segments.translation: 28.a praise which will leave behind the praise of the praisers,

segments.transliteration: h'am-day-yam-laa ar-z''ahoo wasamaaa-ah
segments.translation: 29.a praise which will fill the earth and the heaven!

segments.transliteration: in-nakal-man-naanu bijaseemil-minan
segments.translation: 30.Surely You art the All-kind through immense kindnesses,

segments.transliteration: al-wah-haabu lia'z'eemin-nia'm
segments.translation: 31.the Giver of abounding favours,

segments.transliteration: al-qaabilu yaseeral-h'am-d
segments.translation: 32.the Accepter of small praise,

segments.transliteration: ash-shaakiru qaleelash-shuk-r
segments.translation: 33.the Grateful for little gratitude,

segments.transliteration: al-muh'-sinul-muj-milu d'oot'-t'aw-l
segments.translation: 34.the Beneficent, the Benevolent, Possessor of graciousness!

segments.arabic: لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ إلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ.
segments.transliteration: laaa ilaha il-laaa anta ilay-kal-mas'eer
segments.translation: 35.There is no god but Thou; unto You is the homecoming

segments.transliteration: allahu akbar
segments.translation: Allah is the Most Great.

segments.transliteration: billahi akhruju
segments.translation: I leave (putting my trust) in Allah,

segments.transliteration: wa billahi adkhulu
segments.translation: I return (putting my trust) in Allah,

segments.transliteration: wa `ala allahi atawakkalu
segments.translation: and on Allah do I depend.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱفْتَحْ لِي فِي وَجْهِي هٰذَا بِخَيْرٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma iftah li fi wajhi hadha bikhayrin
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) grant me easiness in the beginning of this affair of mine

segments.transliteration: wakhtim li bikhayrin
segments.translation: seal it for me with easiness,

segments.arabic: وَقِنِي شَرَّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ انْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا
segments.transliteration: wa qini sharra kulli dabbatin anta akhidun binasiyatiha
segments.translation: and guard me against the evil of every living creature that You hold by its forelock.

segments.transliteration: inna rabbi `ala siratin mustaqimin
segments.translation: Surely, my Lord is on the right path.

segments.transliteration: bismillahi wa billahi
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah (I begin) and in Allah (I trust).

segments.transliteration: tawkkaltu `ala allahi
segments.translation: I put my trust in Allah.

segments.transliteration: bismillahi
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah (I begin).

segments.transliteration: hasbiya allahu
segments.translation: Sufficient to me is Allah.

segments.transliteration: wa tawakkaltu `ala allahi
segments.translation: I put my trust in Allah.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اسْالُكَ خَيْرَ امُورِي كُلِّهَا
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka khayra umuri kulliha
segments.translation: O Allah, I beseech You for success in all of my affairs

segments.arabic: وَاعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ خِزْيِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ ٱلآخِرَةِ
segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika min khizyi alddunya wa `adhabi al-akhirati
segments.translation: and I pray Your protection against disgrace in this world and chastisement in the Hereafter.

segments.transliteration: bismillahi
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah (I begin).

segments.transliteration: tawakkaltu `ala allahi
segments.translation: In Allah I put my trust.

segments.arabic: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi
segments.translation: There is neither might nor power except with Allah.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اسْالُكَ خَيْرَ مَا خَرَجْتُ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka khayra ma kharajtu lahu
segments.translation: O Allah, I beseech You for success in what I am leaving to do

segments.arabic: وَاعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَرَجْتُ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika min sharri ma kharajtu lahu
segments.translation: and pray Your protection against failure in what I am leaving to do.

segments.transliteration: allahumma awsi` `alayya min fadlika
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) expand Your favors to me,

segments.transliteration: wa atmim `alayya ni`mataka
segments.translation: make perfect Your graces to me,

segments.transliteration: wasta`milni fi ta`atika
segments.translation: dedicate me to obedience to You,

segments.transliteration: waj`al raghbati fima `indaka
segments.translation: make me desire for what You have in possession,

segments.transliteration: wa tawaffani `ala millatika wa millati rasulika
segments.translation: and cause me to die carrying the principles You have instructed and the principles of Your Messenger,

segments.arabic:
صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
segments.transliteration: ah bless him and his Househo
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

segments.transliteration: bismillahi alrrahman alrrahimi
segments.translation: I am leaving by the might and power of Allah,

segments.transliteration: kharajtu bihawli allahi wa quwwatihi
segments.translation: but not by my own might or power;

segments.transliteration: la bihawlin minni wa quwwati
segments.translation: rather, by the might and power of You, O Lord,

segments.arabic: بَلْ بِحَوْ لِكَ وَقُوَّتِكَ يَا رَبِّ
segments.transliteration: bal bihawlika wa quwwatika ya rabbi
segments.translation: seeking Your sustenance.

segments.transliteration: muta`arridan lirizqika
segments.translation: So, (please) provide me with it easily.

segments.transliteration: fa'tini bihi fi `afiyatin
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) safeguard me and safeguard whatever is with me,

segments.transliteration: allahumma ihfazni wahfaz ma ma`iya
segments.translation: keep me safe and keep safe whatever is with me,

segments.transliteration: wa sallimni wa sallim ma ma`iya
segments.translation: and make me and whatever is with me reach my destination in a perfect way.

segments.arabic: وَبَلِّغْنِي وَبَلِّغْ مَا مَعِيَ بَلاَغاً حَسَناً
segments.transliteration: wa ballighni wa balligh ma ma`iya balaghan hasanan
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah (I begin),

segments.transliteration: bismillahi
segments.translation: in Allah do I believe,

segments.transliteration: amantu billahi
segments.translation: and in Allah do I put my trust.

segments.transliteration: wa tawakkaltu `ala allahi
segments.translation: Only what Allah wills (shall come to pass).

segments.transliteration: ma sha'a allahu
segments.translation: There is neither might nor power except with Allah.

segments.arabic: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi
segments.translation: Peace be on us from our Lord.

segments.transliteration: Assalaamu A'laynaa Min Rabbinaa
segments.translation: O Allah  ! Open for me the doors of Your Mercy.
O Allah  ! Open for me the doors of Your Sustenance.[i]
In the name of Allah  "Allah" . O Allah! Bless Muhammad   and the progeny of Muhammad, and forgive my sins and open for me the doors of Your Mercy.

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ. أَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلـى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اغْفِرْلِي ذُنُوبِي وَ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ.
segments.translation: In the name of Allah  . O Allah! Bless Muhammad   and the progeny of Muhammad, and forgive my sins and open for me the doors of Your Grace.[ii]

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ. أَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلـى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اغْفِرْلِي ذُنُوبِي وَ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ فَضْلِكَ.

segments.arabic: وَإنْ سَبَقَتْ مَغْفِرَتُـكَ لِي فَشَفِّعْنِي فِيْهِمَا،
segments.transliteration: wa in sabaqat maghfiratuka lÄ« fa-shaffiânÄ« fÄ«himÄ,
segments.translation: and if Your forgiveness preceded me, then make me intercede for them,

segments.arabic: حَتّى نَجْتَمِعَ بِرَأفَتِكَ فِي دَارِ كَرَامَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: á¸¥attÄ najtamiâa bi-raâfatika fÄ« dÄri karÄmatik
segments.translation: so that we may gather by Your compassion in the abode of Your honor,

segments.transliteration: wa maá¸¥alli maghfiratika wa raá¸¥matik,
segments.translation: and the place of Your forgiveness and Your mercy.

segments.arabic: إنَّكَ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ وَالْمَنِّ الْقَدِيْمِ
segments.transliteration: innaka dhÅ« al-faá¸li al-âaáºÄ«mi wa al-manni al-qadÄ«m
segments.translation: Truly, You are the Possessor of immense favor and ancient bounty,

segments.transliteration: wa anta ará¸¥amu ar-rÄá¸¥imÄ«n.
segments.translation: and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laamuh'am-madin a'b-dika
segments.translation: 1.O God, bless Muhammad, Your slave

segments.transliteration: wa rasoolika wa ah-li bay-tihit'-t'aahireena
segments.translation: 2.and Your messenger, and his Household, the pure,

segments.arabic: وَاخْصُصْهُمْ بِأَفْضَلِ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ وَبَرَكَاتِكَ وَسَلاَمِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa akh-s'us'-hum bif-z''ali s'alawaatika wa rah'-matika wa barakaatika wa salaamik
segments.translation: 3.and single them out for the best of Your blessings, Your mercy, Your benedictions, and Your peace!

segments.transliteration: wa akh-s'us'il-laahum-ma waaliday-ya bil-karaamati laday-k
segments.translation: 4.And single out my parents, O God, for honour with You

segments.transliteration: was'-s'alaati minka yaaa ar-h'amar-raah'imeen
segments.translation: 5.and blessings from You, O Most Merciful of the merciful!

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih
segments.translation: 6.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَأَلْهِمْنِي عِلْمَ مَا يَجبُ لَهُمَا عَلَىَّ  إلْهَاماً،
segments.transliteration: wa al-him-nee i'l-ma maa yajibu lahumaa a'l-lay il-haamaa
segments.translation: 7.teach me through inspiration knowledge of everything incumbent upon me toward them,

segments.arabic: وَاجْمَعْ لِي عِلْمَ ذلِكَ كُلِّهِ تَمَامـاً،
segments.transliteration: wa aj-maa' lee i'l-ma d'alika kul-lihee tamaamaa
segments.translation: 8.and gather within me knowledge of all that completely!

segments.transliteration: thum-ma as-taa'-mil-nee bimaa tul-himunee min-h
segments.translation: 9.Then make me act in accordance with what You hast inspired me

segments.arabic: وَوَفِّقْنِي لِلنُّفُوذِ  فِيمَا تُبَصِّـرُنِيْ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa waf-fiq-nee liln-nufood'i feemaa tubas'-s'irunee min i'l-mih
segments.translation: 10.and give me the success to put into practice the knowledge You hast shown to me,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى لاَ يَفُوتَنِي اسْتِعْمَالُ شَيْء عَلَّمْتَنِيْهِ،
segments.transliteration: h'at-taa laa yafootanee as-tia'-maalu shay-in a'l-lam-taneeh
segments.translation: 11.lest I fail to act according to something You hast taught me

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَثْقُلَ أَرْكَانِي عَنِ الْحُفُوفِ فِيمَا أَلْهَمْتَنِيهِ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa tath-qula ar-kaanee a'nil-h'ufoofi feemaaa al-ham-taneeh
segments.translation: 12.or my limbs feel too heavy to perform that with which You hast inspired me!

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee
segments.translation: 13.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.transliteration: kamaa shar-raf-tanaa bih
segments.translation: 14.as You hast ennobled us through him,

segments.transliteration: wa s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee
segments.translation: 15.and bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: كَمَا أَوْجَبْتَ لَنَا الْحَقَّ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ بِسَبَبِهِ.
segments.transliteration: kamaaa aw-jab-ta lanaal-h'aq-qa a'laal-khal-qi bisababih
segments.translation: 16.as You hast made incumbent upon us rights toward the creatures because of him!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي أَهَابُهُمَا هَيْبَةَ السُّلْطَانِ الْعَسُوفِ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma aj-a'l-nee ahaabuhumaa hay-batas-sul-t'aanil-a'soof
segments.translation: 17.O God, fill me with awe of my parents, the awe one has toward a tyrannical sovereign,

segments.transliteration: wa abar-ruhumaa bir-ral-um-mir-ra-oof
segments.translation: 18.and let me be devoted to them, with the devotion of a compassionate mother!

segments.transliteration: waj-a'l t'aaa'tee liwaaliday-ya wa bir-ree bihimaa
segments.translation: 19.Make my obedience and devotion to them

segments.transliteration: aqar-ra lia'y-nee mir-raq-datil-was-naan
segments.translation: 20.more gladdening to my eyes than sleep to the drowsy

segments.transliteration: wa ath-laja lis'ad-ree min shar-batiz'-z'am-aaan
segments.translation: 21.and more refreshing to my breast than drink to the thirsty,

segments.transliteration: hat-taaa oothira a'laa hawaaya hawaahumaa
segments.translation: 22.so that I may prefer their inclination to my inclination,

segments.arabic: وَأُقَدِّمَ عَلَى رِضَاىَ رِضَاهُمَا وَأَسْتَكْثِرَ بِرَّهُمَا
segments.transliteration: wa uqad-dima a'laa riz''aaya riz''aahumaa wa as-tak-thira bir-rahumaa
segments.translation: 23.set their satisfaction before my satisfaction, make much of their devotion to me

segments.arabic: بِي وَإنْ قَلَّ وَأَسْتَقِلَّ بِرِّي بِهِمَا وَإنْ كَثُرَ.
segments.transliteration: bee wa in qal wa as-taqil-la bir-ree bihimaa wa in kathur
segments.translation: 24.though it be little, and make little of my devotion to them though it be great.

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma khaf-fiz'' lahumaa s'aw-tee
segments.translation: 25.O God, lower before them my voice,

segments.transliteration: wa at'ib lahumaa kalaamee
segments.translation: 26.make agreeable to them my words,

segments.transliteration: wa alil-lahumaa a'reekatee
segments.translation: 27.make mild before them my temper,

segments.transliteration: wa aa'-t'if a'lay-himaa qal-bee
segments.translation: 28.make tender toward them my heart,

segments.transliteration: wa s'ay-yir-nee bihimaa rafeeqaw-wa a'lay-himaa shafeeqaa
segments.translation: 29.and turn me into their kind companion, their loving friend!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ اشْكُرْ لَهُمَا تَرْبِيَتِي وَأَثِبْهُمَا عَلَى تَكْرِمَتِي،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma ush-kur lahumaa tar-beeatee wa athib-humaa a'laa tak-rimatee
segments.translation: 30.O God, thank them for my upbringing, reward them for honouring me,

segments.arabic: وَاحْفَظْ لَهُمَا  مَا حَفِظَاهُ مِنِّي فِي صِغَرِي.
segments.transliteration: wa ah'-faz' lahumaa maa h'afiz'aahoo min-nee fee s'igharee
segments.translation: 31.and guard them as they guarded me in my infancy!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَمَا مَسَّهُمَا مِنِّي مِنْ أَذَىً أَوْ خَلَصَ إلَيْهِمَا عَنِّي مِنْ  مَكْرُوه
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa maa mas-sahumaa min-nee min ad'ana aw khalas'a ilay-himaa a'n-nee mim-mak-rooh
segments.translation: 32.O God, and whatever harm has touched them from me, detested thing has reached them from me,

segments.arabic: أَوْ ضَاعَ قِبَلِي لَهُمَا مِنْ حَقٍّ
segments.transliteration: aw z''aaa' qibalee lahumaa min h'aq
segments.translation: 33.or right of theirs which has been neglected by me,

segments.transliteration: faj-a'l-h h'it'-t'atal-lid'unoobihimaa
segments.translation: 34.allow it to alleviate their sins,

segments.transliteration: wa u'loo-wan fee darajaatihimaa
segments.translation: 35.raise them in their degrees,

segments.transliteration: wa zeeaadatan fee h'asanaatihimaa
segments.translation: 36.and add to their good deeds!

segments.arabic: يَا مُبَدِّلَ السَّيِّئاتِ بِأَضْعَافِهَا مِنَ الْحَسَنَاتِ.
segments.transliteration: yaa mubad-dilas-say-yi-aati biz''-a'afihaa minal-h'asnaat
segments.translation: 37.O He who changes evil deeds into manifold good deeds!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَمَا تَعَدَّيَا عَلَيَّ فِيهِ مِنْ قَوْل،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa maa taa'd-dayaa a'lay-ya feehee min qaw-l
segments.translation: 38.O God, whatever word through which they have transgressed against me,

segments.arabic: أَوْ أَسْرَفَا عَلَىَّ فِيْهِ مِنْ فِعْل،
segments.transliteration: aw as-rafaa a'lay-ya feehee min fia'-l
segments.translation: 39.act through which they have been immoderate with me,

segments.arabic: أَوْ ضَيَّعَاهُ لِي مِنْ حَقٍّ أَوْ قَصَّرا بِي عَنْهُ مِنْ وَاجِب
segments.transliteration: aw z''ay-yaa'ahoo lee min h'aq aw qas'-s'araa bee a'n-hoo miw-waajib
segments.translation: 40.right of mine which they have left neglected, or obligation toward me in which they have fallen short,

segments.transliteration: faqad wahab-tuhoo lahumaa wa jut-tu bihee a'lay-himaa
segments.translation: 41.I grant it to them and bestow it upon them,

segments.arabic: وَرَغِبْتُ إلَيْكَ فِي وَضْعِ تَبِعَتِهِ عَنْهُمَا
segments.transliteration: wa raghib-tu ilay-ka fee waz''-i' tabia'tihee a'n-humaa
segments.translation: 42.and I beseech You to remove from them its ill consequence,

segments.transliteration: fa in-nee laaa at-tahimuhumaa a'laa naf-see
segments.translation: 43.for I do not accuse them concerning myself,

segments.transliteration: wa laaa as-tab-t'i-uhumaa fee bir-ree
segments.translation: 44.find them slow in their devotion toward me,

segments.arabic: وَلا أكْرَهُ مَا تَوَلَّياهُ مِنْ أَمْرِي يَا رَبِّ
segments.transliteration: wa laaa ak-rahoo maa tawal-layaahoo min am-ree yaa rab
segments.translation: 45.or dislike the way they have attended to my affairs, my Lord!

segments.transliteration: fahumaaa aw-jabu h'aq-qana a'lay
segments.translation: 46.They have rights against me which are more incumbent,

segments.transliteration: wa aq-damu ih'-saanan ilayya
segments.translation: 47.precedence in beneficence toward me that is greater

segments.arabic: وَأَعْظَمُ مِنَّةً لَـدَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أقَاصَّهُمَا بِعَدْل،
segments.transliteration: wa aa'-z'amu min-natal-laday min an uqaaas'-s'ahumaa bia'd-l
segments.translation: 48.and kindness toward me that is mightier than that I should settle accounts with justice

segments.transliteration: aw ujaazeeahumaa a'laa mith-lin
segments.translation: 49.or repay them with equivalents.

segments.arabic: أَيْنَ إذاً  يَا إلهِيْ طُولُ شُغْلِهِمَا بِتَرْبِيَتِي ؟
segments.transliteration: sy-na id'ay-yaaa ilaahee t'oolu shugh-lihimaa bitarbeeatee?
segments.translation: 50.Where then, my God, would be their long occupation with bringing me up?

segments.transliteration: wa ay-na shid-datu taa'bihimaa fee h'iraasatee?
segments.translation: 51.Where the hardship of their toil in taking care of me?

segments.arabic: وَأَيْنَ إقْتَارُهُمَا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمَا لِلتَّوْسِعَةِ عَلَيَّ؟
segments.transliteration: wa ay-na iq-taaruhumaa a'laaa anfusihimaa lilt-taw-sia'ti a'lay-ya?
segments.translation: 52.Where the stinting of themselves to provide me with plenty?

segments.transliteration: hay-haat maa yas-taw-feeaani min-nee h'aq-qahumaa
segments.translation: 53.What an idea! I can never discharge their right against me,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ اُدْرِكُ مَا يَجِبُ عَلَيَّ لَهُمَا
segments.transliteration: wa laaa ud-riku maa yajibu a'lay-ya lahumaa
segments.translation: 54.fulfil my obligations toward them,

segments.transliteration: wa laaa ana biqaaz''iw-waz'eefata khid-matihimaa
segments.translation: 55.or accomplish the duty of serving them.

segments.transliteration: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih
segments.translation: 56.So bless Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَأَعِنِّي يَا خَيْرَ مَنِ اسْتُعِينَ بِهِ.
segments.transliteration: wa ai'n-nee yaa khay-ra mani as-tue'ena bih
segments.translation: 57.and help me, O Best of those whose help we seek!

segments.arabic: وَوَفِّقْنِي يَا أَهْدَى مَنْ رُغِبَ إلَيْهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa waf-fiq-nee yaaa ah-daa mar-rughiba ilay-h
segments.translation: 58.Give me success, O Most Guiding of those whom we beseech!

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْنِي فِي أَهْلِ الْعُقُوقِ لِلآباءِوَالأُمَّهاتِ
segments.transliteration: wa laa taj-a'l-nee feee ah-lil-u'qooqi lil-abaaa-i wal-um-mahaati
segments.translation: 59.Place me not among the people of disrespect to fathers and mothers

segments.arabic: يَوْمَ تُجْزى كُلُّ نَفْس بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لاَيُظْلَمُونَ.
segments.transliteration: (yaw-ma tuj-zaa kul-lu naf-sim-bimaa kasabat wahum laa yuz'-lamoon)
segments.translation: 60.on the day when "every soul will be repaid for what it has earned, they shall not be wronged" (45:22).

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee wad'ur-ree-yatih
segments.translation: 61.O God, bless Muhammad, his Household, and his progeny

segments.arabic: وَاخْصُصْ  أَبَوَيَّ بِأَفْضَلِ مَا خَصَصْتَ بِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa akh-s'us' abaway-ya bif-z''ali maa khas'as'-ta biheee
segments.translation: 62.and single out my parents for the best which You hast singled out for

segments.arabic: آبَاءَ عِبَادِكَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَاُمَّهَاتِهِمْ يَا أَرْحَمَ الـرَّاحِمِينَ.
segments.transliteration: aaabaaa-a i'baadikal-moo-mineena wum-mahaatihim- yaaa ar-h'amar-raah'imeen
segments.translation: 63.the fathers and mothers of Your faithful servants, O Most Merciful of the merciful!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ  لاَ تُنْسِنِي ذِكْرَهُمَا فِي أَدْبَارِ صَلَوَاتِي
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma laa tunsinee d'ik-rahumaa feee ad-baari s'alawaatee
segments.translation: 64.O God, let me not forget to remember them after my ritual prayers,

segments.transliteration: wa feee inana min aaanaaa-i lay-lee
segments.translation: 65.at every time throughout my night,

segments.arabic: وَفِي كُلِّ سَاعَة مِنْ سَاعَاتِ نَهَارِي.
segments.transliteration: wa fee kul-li saaa'tim-min saaa'ati nahaaree
segments.translation: 66.and in each of the hours of my day!

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih
segments.translation: 67.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.transliteration: wa agh-fir lee bidua'aa-ee lahumaa
segments.translation: 68.forgive me through my supplication for my parents,

segments.transliteration: wagh-fir lahumaa bibir-rihimaa bee
segments.translation: 69.and forgive them through their devotion toward me

segments.transliteration: magh-firatan h'at-maa war-z''a a'n-humaa
segments.translation: 70.with unfailing forgiveness, be well pleased with them

segments.transliteration: bishafaaa'tee lahumaa riz''ana a'z-maa
segments.translation: 71.through my intercession for them with resolute good pleasure,

segments.transliteration: wa bal-ligh-humaa bil-karaamati mawaat'inas-salaamah
segments.translation: 72.and make them reach through Your generosity the abodes of safety!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنْ سَبَقَتْ مَغْفِرَتُكَ لَهُمَا فَشَفِّعْهُمَا فِيَّ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa in sabaqat magh-firatuka lahumaa fashaf-fia'-humaa fee
segments.translation: 73.O God, if Your forgiveness reaches them first, make them my intercessors,

segments.arabic: وَإنْ سَبَقَتْ مَغْفِرَتُـكَ لِي فَشَفِّعْنِي فِيْهِمَا،
segments.transliteration: wa in sabaqat magh-firatuka lee fashaf-fia'-nee feehimaa
segments.translation: 74.and if Your forgiveness reaches me first, make me their intercessors,

segments.arabic: حَتّى نَجْتَمِعَ بِرَأفَتِكَ فِي دَارِ كَرَامَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: h'at-taa naj-tamia' biraa-fatika fee daari karaamatika
segments.translation: 75.so that we may gather together through Your gentleness in the house of Your generosity

segments.transliteration: wa mah'al-li magh-firatika warah'-matik
segments.translation: 76.and the place of Your forgiveness and mercy!

segments.arabic: إنَّكَ ذُو الْفَضْلِ  الْعَظِيمِ وَالْمَنِّ الْقَدِيْمِ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ .
segments.transliteration: in-naka d'ool-faz''-lil-a'z'eemi wal-man-nil-qadeem wa anta ar-h'amur-raah'imeen
segments.translation: 77.Verily You art Possessor of abounding bounty and ancient kindness, and "Thou art the Most Merciful of the merciful" (7:151)!

segments.transliteration: rab-bi af-h'amat-nee d'unoobee wanqat'aa't maqaalatee
segments.translation: 1.My Lord, my sins have silenced me, and my words have been cut off.

segments.arabic: فَلاَ حُجَّةَ لِي، فَأَنَا الأَسِيـرُ بِبَلِيَّتِي،
segments.transliteration: falaa h'uj-jata lee faanaal-aseeru bibalee-yatee
segments.translation: 2.I have no argument, for I am the prisoner of my own affliction,

segments.transliteration: al-mur-tahanu bi 'malee al-mutarad-didu fee khat'ee-atee
segments.translation: 3.the hostage to my works, the frequenter of my own offense,

segments.transliteration: al-mutah'ay-yiru a'n qas'-dee al-munqat'iu' bee
segments.translation: 4.the confused in my intended way, the thwarted.

segments.arabic: قَدْ أَوْقَفْتُ نَفْسِي مَوْقِفَ الأَذِلاَّءِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ،
segments.transliteration: qad aw-qaf-tu naf-see maw-qifal-ad'il-laaa-il-mud'-nibeen
segments.translation: 5.I have brought myself to a halt in the halting place of the abased sinners,

segments.arabic: مَوْقِفَ الأَشْقِيآءِ الْمُتَجَرِّينَ عَلَيْكَ، الْمُسْتَخِفِّينَ بِوَعْدِكَ.
segments.transliteration: maw-qifal-ash-qeeaaa-il-mutajar-ri-eena a'lay-kal-mus-takhif-feena biwaa'-dik
segments.translation: 6.the halting place of the wretched and insolent, those who think lightly of Your promise.

segments.transliteration: sub-h'aanaka ay-ya jur-atin aj-taraa-tu a'lay-ka?
segments.translation: 7.Glory be to You! What insolence I have insolently shown toward You!

segments.transliteration: wa ay-ya tagh-reerin ghar-rar-tu binaf-see?
segments.translation: 8.What delusion with which I have deluded myself!

segments.transliteration: maw-laaya ar-h'am- kab-watee lih'ur-ri waj-hee
segments.translation: 9.My Master, have mercy on my falling flat on my face

segments.arabic: وَزَلَّةَ قَدَمِي، وَعُدْ بِحِلْمِكَ عَلَى جَهْلِي،
segments.transliteration: wa zal-lata qadamee wa u'd bh'il-mika a'laa jah-lee
segments.translation: 10.the slipping of my foot, grant me my ignorance through Your clemency,

segments.arabic: وَبِإحْسَانِكَ عَلَى إسَآءَتِي، فَأَنَا الْمُقِرُّ بِذَنْبِي،
segments.transliteration: wa biih'-saanika a'laaa isaaa-atee faanaal-muqir-ru bid'ambee
segments.translation: 11.and my evildoing through Your beneficence, for I admit my sin

segments.transliteration: al-mua'-tarifu bikhat'ee-atee wa hd'ihee yadee wa naas'eeatee
segments.translation: 12.and I confess my offense: Here are my hand and my forelock!

segments.transliteration: as-takeenu bil-qawadi min-naf-see
segments.translation: 13.I am resigned to retaliation against my soul!

segments.transliteration: ir-h'am shay-batee wa nafaada ay-yaamee
segments.translation: 14.Have mercy on my white hair, the depletion of my days,

segments.transliteration: waq-tiraaba ajalee wa z''aa'-fee
segments.translation: 15.the nearing of my term, my frailty,

segments.transliteration: wa mas-kanatee wa qil-lata h'eelatee
segments.translation: 16.my misery, and the paucity of my stratagems!

segments.arabic: مَوْلاَيَ وَارْحَمْنِي إذَا انْقَطَعَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا أَثَرِي،
segments.transliteration: maw-laaya war-h'am-neee id'aa anqat'aa' minad-dunyaaa atharee
segments.translation: 17.My Master, and have mercy upon me when my trace is cut off from this world,

segments.transliteration: wam-mah'aa minal-makh-looqeena d'ik-ree
segments.translation: 18.my mention is effaced among the creatures,

segments.arabic: وَكُنْتُ فِي الْمَنْسِيِّينَ، كَمَنْ قَدْ نُسِيَ.
segments.transliteration: wa kuntu fil-mansee-yeena kaman qad nusee
segments.translation: 19.and I join the forgotten, like the forgotten ones!

segments.transliteration: maw-laaya war-h'am-nee i'nda taghay-yuri s'ooratee
segments.translation: 20.My Master, and have mercy upon me at the change of my form and state

segments.arabic: وَحَالِي إذَا بَلِيَ جِسْمِي، وَتَفَرَّقَتْ أَعْضَائِي،
segments.transliteration: wa h'aalee id'aa baleea jis-mee wa tafar-raqat aa'-z''aaa-ee
segments.translation: 21.when my body decays, my limbs are scattered,

segments.arabic: وَتَقَطَّعَتْ أَوْصَالِيْ، يا غَفْلَتِي  عَمَّا يُرَادُ بِيَ.
segments.transliteration: wa taqat'-t'aa't aw-s'aalee yaa ghaf-latee a'm-maa yuraadu bee
segments.translation: 22.and my joints are dismembered! O my heedlessness toward what was wanted from me!

segments.transliteration: maw-laaya war-h'amnee fee h'ash-ree wa nash-ree
segments.translation: 23.My Master, have mercy upon me at my mustering and uprising

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَل فِي ذَلِكَ الْيَومِ مَعَ أَوْلِيَآئِكَ مَوْقِفِي،
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l fee d'alikal-yawmi maa' aw-leeaaa-ika maw-qifee
segments.translation: 24.and on that day, appoint my standing place with Your friends,

segments.transliteration: wa feee ah'ib-baaa-ika mas'-daree
segments.translation: 25.my place of emergence with Your beloveds,

segments.arabic: وَفِي جِوَارِكَ مَسْكَنِي يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
segments.transliteration: wa fee jiwaarika mas-kanee yaa rab-bal-a'alameen
segments.translation: 26.and my dwelling in Your neighbourhood! O Lord of the worlds!

segments.transliteration: bismi allahi alrrahmani alrrahimi
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ دَلَعَ لِسَانَ ٱلصَّبَاحِ بِنُطْقِ تَبَلُّجِهِ
segments.transliteration: allahumma ya man dala`a lisana alssabahi binutqi taballujihi
segments.translation: O Allah, O He Who extended the morning's tongue in the speech of its dawning,

segments.arabic: وَسَرَّحَ قِطَعَ ٱللَّيْلِ ٱلْمُظْلِمِ بِغَيَاهِبِ تَلَجْلُجِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa sarraha qita`a allayli almuzlimi bighayahibi talajlujihi
segments.translation: dispatched the fragments of the dark night into the gloom of its stammering,

segments.arabic: وَأَتْقَنَ صُنْعَ ٱلْفَلَكِ الدَّوَّارِ فِي مَقَادِيرِ تَبَرُّجِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa atqana sun`a alfalaki alddawwari fi maqadiri tabarrujihi
segments.translation: made firm the structure of the turning spheres in the measure of its display,

segments.transliteration: wa sha`sha`a diya'a alshshamsi binuri ta'ajjujihi
segments.translation: and beamed forth the brightness of the sun through the light of its blazing!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ دَلَّ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِهِ بِذَاتِهِ
segments.transliteration: ya man dalla `ala dhatihi bidhatihi
segments.translation: O He Who demonstrates His Essence by His Essence,

segments.transliteration: wa tanazzaha `an mujanasati makhluqatihi
segments.translation: transcends from congeniality with His creatures,

segments.transliteration: wa jalla `an mula'amati kayfiyyatihi
segments.translation: and is exalted beyond conformity with His qualities!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ قَرُبَ مِنْ خَطَرَاتِ ٱلظُّنُونِ
segments.transliteration: ya man qaruba min khatarati alzzununi
segments.translation: O He Who is near to the passing thoughts of opinions,

segments.transliteration: wa ba`uda `an lahazati al`uyuni
segments.translation: far from the regards of eyes,

segments.arabic: وَعَلِمَ بِمَا كَانَ قَبْلَ أَن يَكُونَ
segments.transliteration: wa `alima bima kana qabla an yakuna
segments.translation: and knows what will be before it comes to be!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ أَرْقَدَنِي فِي مِهَادِ أَمْنِهِ وَأَمَانِهِ
segments.transliteration: ya man arqadani fi mihadi amnihi wa amanihi
segments.translation: O He Who has put me at ease in the cradle of His security and sanctuary,

segments.arabic: وَأَيْقَظَنِي إِلَىٰ مَا مَنَحَنِي بِهِ مِنْ مِنَنِهِ وَإِحْسَانِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa ayqazani ila ma manahani bihi min minanihi wa ihsanihi
segments.translation: awakened me to the favors and kindness that He has bestowed upon me,

segments.arabic: وَكَفَّ أَكُفَّ السُّوءِ عَنِّي بِيَدِهِ وَسُلْطَانِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa kaffa akuffa alssu'i `anni biyadihi wa sultanihi
segments.translation: and held back from me the claws of evil with His hand and His authority!

segments.arabic: صَلِّ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَىٰ ٱلدَّلِيلِ إِلَيْكَ فِي ٱللَّيْلِ ٱلأَلْيَلِ
segments.transliteration: salli allahumma `ala alddalili ilayka fi allayli al-alyali
segments.translation: Bless, O Allah, the guide to You in the darkest night,

segments.arabic: وَٱلْمَاسِكِ مِنْ أَسْبَابِكَ بِحَبْلِ ٱلشَّرَفِ ٱلأَطْوَلِ
segments.transliteration: walmasiki min asbabika bihabli alshsharafi al-atwali
segments.translation: who, of Your ropes, clings to the cord of the longest nobility,

segments.arabic: وَٱلنَّاصِعِ ٱلْحَسَبِ فِي ذِرْوَةِ ٱلْكَاهِلِ ٱلأَعْبَلِ
segments.transliteration: walnnasi`i alhasabi fi dhirwati alkahili al-a`bali
segments.translation: whose pure lineage evident at the summit of stout shoulders,

segments.arabic: وَٱلثَّابِتِ ٱلْقَدَمِ عَلَىٰ زَحَاِليْفِهَا فِي ٱلزَّمَنِ ٱلأَوَّلِ
segments.transliteration: walththabiti alqadami `ala zahalifiha fi alzzamani al-awwali
segments.translation: and whose feet were entrenched in spite of slippery places in ancient time.

segments.transliteration: wa `ala alihi al-akhyari almustafayna al-abrari
segments.translation: And [bless] his household, the good, chosen, and pious.

segments.transliteration: waftah allahumma lana masari`a alssabahi
segments.translation: Open for us, O Allah, the leaves of the morning's door

segments.transliteration: bimafatihi alrrahmati walfalahi
segments.translation: with the keys of mercy and prosperity!

segments.arabic: وَأَلْبِسْنِي ٱللَّهُمَّ مِنْ أَفْضَلِ خِلَعِ ٱلْهِدَايَةِ وَٱلصَّلاَحِ
segments.transliteration: wa albisni allahumma min afdali khila`i alhidayati walssalahi
segments.translation: Clothe me, O Allah, with the most excellent robes of guidance and righteousness!

segments.arabic: وَٱغْرِسِ اللَّهُمَّ بِعَظَمَتِكَ فِي شِرْبِ جَنَانِي يَنَابِيعَ ٱلْخُشُوعِ
segments.transliteration: wa ighris allahumma bi`azamatika fi shirbi janani yanabi`a alkhushu`i
segments.translation: Plant, O Allah, through Your tremendousness, the springs of humility in the watering place of my heart!

segments.arabic: وَأَجْرِ ٱللَّهُمَّ لِهَيْبَتِكَ مِنْ آمَاقِي زَفَرَاتِ ٱلدُّمُوعِ
segments.transliteration: wa ajri allahumma lihaybatika min amaqi zafarati alddumu`i
segments.translation: Cause to flow, O Allah, through fear of You, tears of moaning from the corners of my eyes!

segments.arabic: وَأَدِّبِ ٱللَّهُمَّ نَزَقَ ٱلْخُرْقِ مِنِّي بِأَزِمَّةِ ٱلْقُنُوعِ
segments.transliteration: wa addib allahumma nazaqa alkhurqi minni bi-azimmati alqunu`i
segments.translation: Chastise, O Allah, the recklessness of my clumsiness with the reins of contentment!

segments.arabic: إِلٰهِي إِن لَمْ تَبْتَدِئْنِي ٱلرَّحْمَةُ مِنْكَ بِحُسْنِ ٱلتَّوْفِيقِ
segments.transliteration: ilahi in lam tabtadi'ni alrrahmatu minka bihusni alttawfiqi
segments.translation: My God, if mercy from You does not begin with fair success for me,

segments.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱلسَّاِلكُ بِي إِلَيْكَ فِي وَاضِحِ ٱلطَّرِيقِ
segments.transliteration: faman alssaliku bi ilayka fi wadihi alttariqi
segments.translation: then who can take me to You upon the evident path?

segments.arabic: وَإِنْ أَسْلَمَتْنِي أَنَاتُكَ لِقَائِدِ ٱلأَمَلِ وَٱلْمُنَىٰ
segments.transliteration: wa in aslamatni anatuka liqa'idi al-amali walmuna
segments.translation: If Your deliberateness should turn me over to the guide of hope and wishes,

segments.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱلْمُقِيلُ عَثَرَاتِي مِنْ كَبَوَاتِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
segments.transliteration: faman almuqilu `atharati min kabawati alhawa
segments.translation: then who will annul my slips from the stumbles of caprice?

segments.arabic: وَإِنْ خَذَلَنِي نَصْرُكَ عِنْدَ مُحَارَبَةِ ٱلنَّفْسِ وَٱلشَّيْطَانِ
segments.transliteration: wa in khadhalani nasruka `inda muharabati alnnafsi walshshaytani
segments.translation: If Your help should forsake me in the battle against the soul and Satan,

segments.arabic: فَقَدْ وَكَلَنِي خِذْلاَنُكَ إِلَىٰ حَيْثُ ٱلنَّصَبِ وَٱلْحِرْمَانِ
segments.transliteration: faqad wakalani khidhlanuka ila haythu alnnasabi walhirmani
segments.translation: then Your forsaking will have submitted me to where there is hardship and deprivation.

segments.arabic: إِلٰهِي أَتَرَانِي مَا أَتَيْتُكَ إِلاَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ ٱلآمَاِل
segments.transliteration: ilahi atarani ma ataytuka illa min haythu al-amali
segments.translation: My God, do You see that I have only come to You from the direction of hopes,

segments.arabic: أَمْ عَلِقْتُ بِأَطْرَافِ حِبَاِلكَ إِلاَّ حِينَ بَاعَدَتْنِي ذُنُوبِي عَنْ دَارِ ٱلْوِصَاِل
segments.transliteration: am `aliqtu bi-atrafi hibalika illa hina ba`adatni dhunubi `an dari alwisali
segments.translation: or clung to the ends of Your cords when my sins have driven me from the house of union?

segments.arabic: فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَطِيَّةُ الَّتِي ٱمْتَطَتْ نَفْسِي مِنْ هَوَاهَا
segments.transliteration: fabi'sa almatiyyatu allati imtatat nafsi min hawaha
segments.translation: So what an evil mount upon which my soul has mounted-its caprice!

segments.arabic: فَوَاهاً لَهَا لِمَا سَوَّلَتْ لَهَا ظُنُونُهَا وَمُنَاهَا
segments.transliteration: fawahan laha lima sawwalat laha zununuha wa munaha
segments.translation: Woe upon it for being seduced by its own opinions and wishes!

segments.arabic: وَتَبّاً لَهَا لِجُرْأَتِهَا عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِهَا وَمَوْلاهَا
segments.transliteration: wa tabban laha lijur'atiha `ala sayyidiha wa mawlaha
segments.translation: Destruction be upon it for its audacity toward its Master and Protector!

segments.arabic: إِلٰهِي قَرَعْتُ بَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ بِيَدِ رَجَائِي
segments.transliteration: ilahi qara`tu baba rahmatika biyadi raja'i
segments.translation: My God, I have knocked upon the door of Your mercy with the hand of my hope,

segments.arabic: وَهَرَبْتُ إِلَيْكَ لاَجِئاً مِنْ فَرْطِ أَهْوَائِي
segments.transliteration: wa harabtu ilayka laji'an min farti ahwa'i
segments.translation: fled to You seeking refuge from my excessive caprice,

segments.transliteration: wa `allaqtu bi-atrafi hibalika anamila wala'i
segments.translation: and fixed the fingers of my love to the ends of Your cords.

segments.arabic: فَٱصْفَحِ اللَّهُمَّ عَمَّا كُنتُ أَجْرَمْتُهُ مِنْ زَلَلِي وَخَطَائِي
segments.transliteration: fasfah allahumma `amma kuntu ajramtuhu min zalali wa khata'i
segments.translation: So pardon, O Allah, the slips and errors I have committed,

segments.transliteration: wa aqilni min sar`ati rida'i
segments.translation: and release me from the foot-tangling of my robe,

segments.transliteration: fa'innaka sayyidi wa mawlaya wa mu`tamadi wa raja'i
segments.translation: for You are my Master, my Protector, my Support and my Hope,

segments.arabic: وَأَنتَ غَايَةُ مَطْلُوبِي وَمُنَايَ فِي مُنْقَلَبِي وَمَثْوايَ
segments.transliteration: wa anta ghayatu matlubi wa munaya fi munqalabi wa mathwaya
segments.translation: and You are the object of my search and my desire in my ultimate end and stable abode.

segments.arabic: إِلٰهِي كَيْفَ تَطْرُدُ مِسْكِيناً ٱلْتَجَأَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلذُّنُوبِ هَارِباً
segments.transliteration: ilahi kayfa tatrudu miskinan iltaja'a ilayka mina aldhdhunubi hariban
segments.translation: My God, how could You drive away a poor beggar who seeks refuge in You from sins, fleeing?

segments.arabic: أَم كَيْفَ تُخَيِّبُ مُستَرْشِداً قَصَدَ إِلَىٰ جَنَابِكَ سَاعِياً
segments.transliteration: am kayfa tukhayyibu mustarshidan qasada ila janabika sa`iyan
segments.translation: How could You disappoint one seeking guidance who repairs to Your threshold, running?

segments.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ تَرُدُّ ظَمْآناً وَرَدَ إِلَىٰ حِيَاضِكَ شَارِباً
segments.transliteration: am kayfa taruddu zam'anan warada ila hiyadika shariban
segments.translation: How could You reject a thirsty man who comes to Your pools to drink?

segments.arabic: كَلاَّ وَحِيَاضُكَ مُتْرَعَةٌ فِي ضَنْكِ ٱلْمُحُولِ
segments.transliteration: kalla wa hiyaduka mutra`atun fi danki almuhuli
segments.translation: Never! For Your pools are full in the hardship of drought,

segments.transliteration: wa babuka maftuhun lilttalabi walwughuli
segments.translation: Your door is open for seeking and penetration,

segments.transliteration: wa anta ghayatu almas'uli wa nihayatu alma'muli
segments.translation: and You are the goal of requests and the object of hopes.

segments.arabic: إِلٰهِي هٰذِهِ أَزِمَّةُ نَفْسِي عَقَلْتُهَا بِعِقَاِل مَشِيئَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: ilahi hadhihi azimmatu nafsi `aqaltuha bi`iqali mashi'atika
segments.translation: My God, these are the reins of my soul I have bounded with the ties of Your will.

segments.arabic: وَهٰذِهِ أَعْبَاءُ ذُنُوبِي دَرَاْتُهَا بِعَفْوِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa hadhihi a`ba'u dhunubi dara'tuha bi`afwika wa rahmatika
segments.translation: These are the burdens of my sins I have averted with Your pardon and mercy.

segments.arabic: وَهٰذِهِ أَهْوَائِيَ ٱلْمُضِلَّةُ وَكَلْتُهَا إِلَىٰ جَنَابِ لُطفِكَ وَرَاْفَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa hadhihi ahwa'i almudillatu wakaltuha ila janabi lutfika wa ra'fatika
segments.translation: These are my misleading caprices I have referred to the threshold of Your gentleness and kindliness.

segments.arabic: فَٱجْعَلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ صَبَاحِي هٰذَا نَازِلاً عَلَيَّ بِضِيَاءِ ٱلْهُدَىٰ
segments.transliteration: faj`al allahumma sabahi hadha nazilan `alayya bidiya'i alhuda
segments.translation: So, make this morning of mine, O Allah, descend upon me with the radiance of guidance

segments.transliteration: wa bilssalamati fi alddini walddunya
segments.translation: and safety in religion and this world!

segments.transliteration: wa masa'i junnatan min kaydi al`ida
segments.translation: And [make] my evening a shield against the deception of enemies

segments.transliteration: wa wiqayatan min murdiyati alhawa
segments.translation: and a protection against the destructive blows of caprice!

segments.transliteration: innaka qadirun `ala ma tasha'u
segments.translation: Verily, You have power to do what You will!

segments.transliteration: tu'ti almulka man tasha'u
segments.translation: You give the kingdom to whom You will,

segments.transliteration: wa tanzi`u almulka mimman tasha'u
segments.translation: seize the kingdom from whom You will,

segments.transliteration: wa tu`izzu man tasha'u
segments.translation: exalt whom You will,

segments.transliteration: wa tudhillu man tasha'u
segments.translation: and abase whom You will.

segments.transliteration: biyadika alkhayru
segments.translation: In Your hand is the good

segments.transliteration: innaka `ala kulli shay'in qadirun
segments.translation: and You are powerful over all things.

segments.transliteration: tuliju allayla fi alnnahari
segments.translation: You make the night to enter into the day,

segments.transliteration: wa tuliju alnnahara fi allayli
segments.translation: make the day to enter into the night,

segments.transliteration: wa tukhriju alhayya mina almayyiti
segments.translation: bring forth the living from the dead,

segments.transliteration: wa tukhriju almayyita mina alhayyi
segments.translation: bring forth the dead from the living,

segments.transliteration: wa tarzuqu man tasha'u bighayri hisabin
segments.translation: and provide whomsoever You will without measure!

segments.transliteration: la ilaha illa anta
segments.translation: There is no god but You!

segments.transliteration: subhanaka allahumma wa bihamdika
segments.translation: Glory be to You, O Allah, and Yours is the praise!

segments.arabic: مَنْ ذَا يَعْرِفُ قَدْرَكَ فَلاَ يَخَافُكَ
segments.transliteration: man dha ya`rifu qadraka fala yakhafuka
segments.translation: Who knows Your measure and yet does not fear You?

segments.arabic: وَمَن ذَا يَعْلَمُ مَا أَنتَ فَلاَ يَهَابُكَ
segments.transliteration: wa man dha ya`lamu ma anta fala yahabuka
segments.translation: Who knows what You are and yet does not stand in awe of You?

segments.transliteration: allafta biqudratika alfiraqa
segments.translation: Through Your power, You have joined disparate things,

segments.transliteration: wa falaqta bilutfika alfalaqa
segments.translation: through Your gentleness, You have cleaved apart the daybreak,

segments.transliteration: wa anarta bikaramika dayajiya alghasaqi
segments.translation: through Your generosity, You have illumined the dark shrouds of night,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْهَرْتَ ٱلْمِيَاهَ مِنَ ٱلصُّمِّ ٱلصَّيَاخِيدِ عَذْباً وَأُجَاجاً
segments.transliteration: wa anharta almiyaha mina alssummi alssayakhidi `adhban wa ujajan
segments.translation: made waters, sweet and salt, flow forth from hard shining stones,

segments.transliteration: wa anzalta mina almu`sirati ma'an thajjajan
segments.translation: sent dawn out of rain-clouds water cascading,

segments.arabic: وَجَعَلْتَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ لِلْبَرِيَّةِ سِرَاجاً وَهَّاجاً
segments.transliteration: wa ja`alta alshshamsa walqamara lilbariyyati sirajan wahhajan
segments.translation: and appointed the sun and the moon a blazing lamp for the creatures

segments.arabic: مِنْ غَيْرِ أَن تُمَارِسَ فِيمَا ٱبْتَدَأْتَ بِهِ لُغُوباً وَلاَ عِلاَجاً
segments.transliteration: min ghayri an tumarisa fima ibtada'ta bihi lughuban wa la `ilajan
segments.translation: without experiencing in that which You originated either weariness or effort.

segments.transliteration: faya man tawahhada bil`izzi walbaqa'i
segments.translation: So, O He Who is alone in might and subsistence

segments.transliteration: wa qahara `ibadahu bilmawti walfana'i
segments.translation: and dominates His slaves with death and annihilation,

segments.transliteration: salli `ala muhammadin wa alihi al-atqiya'i
segments.translation: (please) bless Muhammad and his household, the god-fearing,

segments.transliteration: wasma` nida'i wastajib du`a'i
segments.translation: answer my supplication, hear my call,

segments.transliteration: wa haqqiq bifadlika amali wa raja'i
segments.translation: and actualize through Your favor my hope and desire.

segments.arabic: يَا خَيْرَ مَنْ دُعِيَ لِكَشْفِ ٱلضُّرِّ
segments.transliteration: ya khayra man du`iya likashfi alddurri
segments.translation: O Best of those who are called to remove affliction

segments.transliteration: walma'muli fi kulli `usrin wa yusrin
segments.translation: and object of hope in difficulty and ease!

segments.arabic: بِكَ أَنزَلْتُ حَاجَتِي فَلاَ تَرُدَّنِي مِنْ سَنِيِّ مَوَاهِبِكَ خَائِباً
segments.transliteration: bika anzaltu hajati fala taruddani min saniyyi mawahibika kha'iban
segments.translation: I have stated my need to You; so, do not reject me despairing of Your exalted gifts.

segments.arabic: يَا كَرِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ
segments.transliteration: ya karimu ya karimu ya karimu
segments.translation: O All-generous! O All-generous! O All-generous!

segments.transliteration: birahmatika ya arhama alrrahimina
segments.translation: By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful!

segments.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala khayri khalqihi
segments.translation: May Allah bless the best of His creatures,

segments.transliteration: muhammadin wa alihi ajma`ina
segments.translation: Muhammad, and his entire Household!

segments.transliteration: ilahi qalbi mahjubun
segments.translation: My God, my heart is veiled,

segments.transliteration: wa nafsi ma`yubun
segments.translation: my soul is deficient,

segments.transliteration: wa `aqli maghlubun
segments.translation: my intelligence is defeated,

segments.transliteration: wa hawa'i ghalibun
segments.translation: my caprice is triumphant,

segments.transliteration: wa ta`ati qalilun
segments.translation: my obedience is little,

segments.transliteration: wa ma`siyati kathirun
segments.translation: my disobedience is much,

segments.transliteration: wa lisani muqirrun bildhdhnubi
segments.translation: and my tongue confesses of sinning;

segments.transliteration: fakayfa hilati ya sattara al`uyubi
segments.translation: so, what am I to do?

segments.transliteration: wa ya `allama alghuyubi
segments.translation: O He Who covers defects!

segments.transliteration: wa ya kashifa alkurubi
segments.translation: O He Who knows the unseen!

segments.transliteration: ighfir dhunubi kulliha
segments.translation: O He Who removes troubles!

segments.transliteration: bihurmati muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: Forgive my sins, all of them,

segments.transliteration: ya ghaffaru ya ghaffaru ya ghaffaru
segments.translation: in the name of the sacredness of Muhammad and the household of Muhammad!

segments.arabic: يَا غَفَّارُ يَا غَفَّارُ يَا غَفَّارُ
segments.transliteration: birahmatika ya arhama alrrahimina
segments.translation: O All-forgiver! O All-forgiver! O All-forgiver!

segments.transliteration: ilahi qalbi mahjubun
segments.translation: By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful!

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى حُسْنِ قَضَائِكَ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma laka al-á¸¥amdu âalÄ á¸¥usni qaá¸Äâika,
segments.translation: O Allah, to You belongs all praise for the goodness of Your decree,

segments.transliteration: Wa-bimÄ á¹£arafta âannÄ« min balÄâika,
segments.translation: And for what You have averted from me of Your trials,

segments.arabic: فَلاَ تَجْعَلْ حَظِّي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ لِي مِنْ عَافِيَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: FalÄ tajâal á¸¥aáºáºÄ« min raá¸¥matika mÄ âajjalta lÄ« min âÄfiyatika,
segments.translation: So do not make my share of Your mercy what You hastened for me of well-being,

segments.arabic: فَأَكُونَ قَدْ شَقِيتُ بِمَا أَحْبَبْتُ وَسَعِدَ غَيْرِي بِمَا كَرِهْتُ،
segments.transliteration: Fa-akÅ«na qad shaqÄ«tu bimÄ aá¸¥babtu wa-saâida ghayrÄ« bimÄ karihtu,
segments.translation: So that I may end up wretched through what I loved, while others are happy with what I disliked,

segments.arabic: وَإِنْ يَكُنْ مَا ظَلِلْتُ فِيهِ أَوْ بِتُّ فِيهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْعَافِيَةِ،
segments.transliteration: Wa-in yakun mÄ áºaliltu fÄ«hi aw bitu fÄ«hi min hÄdhihi al-âÄfiyah,
segments.translation: And if what I spent my day or night in of this well-being,

segments.arabic: بَيْنَ يَدَيْ بَلاءٍ لاَ يَنْقَطِعُ وَوِزْرٍ لاَ يَرْتَفِعُ،
segments.transliteration: Bayna yaday balÄâin lÄ yanqaá¹­iâu wa-wizrin lÄ yartafiâu,
segments.translation: Is before a trial that does not cease, and a burden that does not lift,

segments.arabic: فَقَدِّمْ لِي مَا أَخَّرْتَ وَأَخِّرْ عَنِّي مَا قَدَّمْتَ،
segments.transliteration: Faqaddim lÄ« mÄ akhkharta wa-akhkhir âannÄ« mÄ qaddamta,
segments.translation: Then advance for me what You have delayed, and delay from me what You have advanced,

segments.arabic: فَغَيْرُ كَثِيرٍ مَا عَاقِبَتُهُ الْفَنَاءُ وَغَيْرُ قَلِيلٍ مَا عَاقِبَتُهُ الْبَقَاءُ،
segments.transliteration: Faghayru kathÄ«rin mÄ âÄqibatuhu al-fanÄâ wa-ghayru qalÄ«lin mÄ âÄqibatuhu al-baqÄâ,
segments.translation: For what ends in perishing is not great, and what ends in lasting is not small,

segments.transliteration: Wa-á¹£alli âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa-Älihi,
segments.translation: And send blessings upon Muhammad and his family.

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى حُسْنِ قَضَائِكَ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma lakal-h'am-du a'laa h'us-ni qaz''aaa-ik
segments.translation: 1.O God, to You belongs praise for Your excellent accomplishment

segments.transliteration: wa bimaa s'araf-ta a'n-nee mim-balaaa-ik
segments.translation: 2.and for Your trial which You hast turned away from me!

segments.arabic: فَلاَ تَجْعَـلْ حَظِّي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ لِي مِنْ عَافِيَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: falaa taj-a'l h'az'-z'ee mir-rah'-matika maa a'j-jal-ta lee min a'afeeatika
segments.translation: 3.But make not my share of Your mercy the well-being which You hast quickly granted to me,

segments.arabic: فَأكُونَ قَدْ شَقِيتُ بِمَا أَحْبَبْتُ وَسَعِدَ غَيْرِي بِمَا كَرِهْتُ،
segments.transliteration: faakoona qad- shaqeetu bimaaa ah'-bab-t wa sai'da ghay-ree bimaa karih-t
segments.translation: 4.lest I become wretched through what I have loved and someone else gain felicity through what I have disliked!

segments.arabic: وَإنْ يَكُنْ مَا ظَلِلْتُ فِيهِ أَوْ بِتُّ فِيهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْعَافِيَةِ
segments.transliteration: wa ee-yakum-maa z'alil-tu feeheee aw bit-tu feehee min had'ihil-a'afeeah
segments.translation: 5.If this well-being in which I pass the day or night

segments.arabic: بَيْنَ يَدَيْ بَلاء لاَ يَنْقَطِعُ، وَوِزْر لاَ يَرْتَفِعُ
segments.transliteration: bay-na yaday balaaa-il-laa yanqat'ia'- wa wiz-ril-laa yar-tafia'-
segments.translation: 6.should precede a trial that does not cease and a burden that does not pass away,

segments.arabic: فَقَدِّمْ لِي مَا أَخَّرْتَ وَأَخِّرْ عَنّي مَا قَدَّمْتَ
segments.transliteration: faqad-dim lee maaa akh-khar-t wa akh-khir a'n-nee maa qad-dam-t
segments.translation: 7.then set before me what You hadst set behind and set behind me what You hadst set before!

segments.transliteration: faghay-ru katheerim-maa a'aqibatuhul-fanaaa-
segments.translation: 8.For that which ends in annihilation is not great

segments.transliteration: wa ghay-ru qaleelim-maa a'aqibatuhul-baqaaa-
segments.translation: 9.and that which ends in subsistence is not little.

segments.transliteration: wa s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih
segments.translation: 10.And bless Muhammad and his Household!
