segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِحَقِّ الْعَرْشِ وَ مَنْ عَلاَهُ وَ بِحَقِّ الْوَحْيِ وَ مَنْ أَوْحَاهُ
segments.transliteration: Allahumma Bi Haqqil Arshi Wa Man 'Alaahu Wa Bi Haqqil Wahee Wa Man Awhaahu
segments.translation: O' Allah! for the sake of the Throne and the One Who is above it, and for the sake of Revelation and the One Who revealed it,

segments.arabic: وَ بِحَقِّ النَّبِيِّ وَ مَنْ نَبَّأَهُ وَ بِحَقِّ الْبَيْتِ وَ مَنْ بَنَاهُ
segments.transliteration: Wa Bi Haqqinnabee'ee Wa Mannabbaahu Wa Bi Haqqil Bayti Wa Man Banaahu.
segments.translation: and for the sake of the Prophet and the One Who appointed him, and for the sake of the House and the One Who constructed it.

segments.arabic: يَا سَامِعَ كُلِّ صَوْتٍ يَا جَامِعَ كُلِّ فَوْتٍ يَا بَارِئَ النُّفُوسِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
segments.transliteration: Ya Saamia' Kulli Sawt. Yaa Jaamia' Kulli Fawt. Yaa Baarian Nufuusi Badal Mawt. Salli 'Ala Muhammad Wa Ahle Bayte-Hee
segments.translation: O' Hearer of every sound! O' Collector of all that will pass. O' Creator of the souls after (their) death. Send Your blessings on Muhammad and his family

segments.arabic: وَ آتِنَا وَ جَمِيعَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ فِي مَشَارِقِ الْأَرْضِ وَ مَغَارِبِهَا فَرَجاً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ عَاجِلاً بِشَهَادَةِ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: Wa Aatinaa Wa Jameefal Mo'meneen Wal Mo'menaat Fee Mashaariqal Ardhee Wa Maghaaribihaa Farajan Min 'Indika 'Aajilan Bi Shahaadati An Laa Ilaha Illa Allaah
segments.translation: and grant us and (grant all) the believing men and believing women in the east of the Earth and the west of if (the Earth) deliverance from Yourself, speedily (in this world), with the bearing witness that there is no god except Allah

segments.arabic: وَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَ رَسُولُكَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ عَلَى ذُرِّيَّتِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ وَ سَلَّمَ تَسْلِيماً كَثِيراً
segments.transliteration: Wa An-Na Muhammadan 'Abduka Wa Rasuluka. Salla Allahu 'Alayhi Wa Aalehee Wa 'Ala Dhuriyateheet Tayyibeenat Taaheereen Wa Salla-Ma Tasleeman Katheera.
segments.translation: and verily Muhammad is Your slave and Your Prophet, blessings of Allah be upon him and upon his family and upon his children, the righteous and pure, and send salutations (upon them), an appropriate salutation in multitude.

segments.transliteration: Allahumma Eeyaaka Arjuu Wa Eeyaaka Ad'oou Fa Bal-Ligh-Nee Amalee Wa Aslih 'Amalee.
segments.translation: O' Allah! Verily we turn to You and verily we call upon You, so help me to reach my hopes and desires and make my actions righteous.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَلْكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ وَ الْمُعَافَاةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma Innee As-Alukal A'fwa Wal A'afiyata Wal Mu-A'afaata Fid Dunyaa Wal Aakhirati
segments.translation: Oh God, I ask you for forgiveness, well-being, and well-being in this world and the hereafter.

segments.arabic: يَا مُخَلَّصَ الشَّجَرِ مِنْ بَيْنِ رَمْلٍ وَ طِينِ وَمَاءِ وَ يَا مُخَلِّصَ اللَّبَنِ مِنْ بَيْنِ فَرْثٍ وَ دَمٍ وَ يَا مُخَلَّصَ الْوَلَدِ مِنْ بَيْنِ مَشِيمَةٍ رَحِمٍ وَ يَا مُخَلِّصَ النَّارِ مِنْ بَيْنِ الْحَدِيدِ وَ الْحَجَرِ وَ يَا مُخَلِّصَ الرُّوحِ مِنْ بَيْنِ الْأَحْشَاءِ وَ الْأَمْعَاءِ خَلَصْنِي مِنْ يَدَى ......
segments.transliteration: Yaa Mukhallis'ash Shajari Min Bayni Ramlin Wa T'eenin Wa Maa-In Wa Yaa Mukhallis'al Labani Min Bayni Farthin Wa Damin Wa Yaa Mukhallis'al Waladi Min Bayni Masheematin Wa Rah'imin Wa Yaa Mukhallis'an Naari Min Baynil H'adeedi Wal H'ajari Wa Yaa Mukhallisar Rooh'i Min Baynil Ah'shaa-I Wal Am-A'a-I Khallis'nee Min Yadayo
segments.translation: O Savior of trees from between sand and clay and water, O Savior of milk from between dung and blood, O Savior of the child from between the placenta of a womb, and O Savior The fire is from between the iron and the stone, and O Savior of the soul, from between the entrails and the intestines, save me from my hand......

segments.arabic: يَا مُخَلِصَ اللَّبْنَ مِنْ بَيْنِ فَرْثٍ وَ دَمٍ نَجِّنِي مِنَ الْمَحْبَسِ بِحَقِّ عِبَادِكَ الْمُخْلِصِ
segments.transliteration: Ya mukhalis alllabn min bayn farth w dam najjini min almahbas bihaqq eibadik almukhlis
segments.translation: O the One who has purified the milk (that comes) from between the refuse and blood. Save me from the prison for the sake of your sincere servants.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِحَقِّ الْعَرْشِ وَ مَنْ عَلَاهُ،
segments.transliteration: Allahumma bihaqqi al-'arshi wa man 'alahu,
segments.translation: O Allah, by the right of the Throne and its bearer,

segments.arabic: وَ بِحَقِّ الْوَحِي وَ مَنْ أَوْحَاهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa bihaqqi al-wahi wa man awhahu,
segments.translation: and by the right of the Revelation and its receiver,

segments.arabic: وَ بِحَقِّ النَّبِيِّ وَ مَنْ نَبَّاهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa bihaqqi al-nabiyyi wa man nabba'ahu,
segments.translation: and by the right of the Prophet and his teachings,

segments.arabic: وَ بِحَقِّ الْبَيْتِ وَ مَنْ بَنَاهُ.
segments.transliteration: wa bihaqqi al-bayti wa man banahu,
segments.translation: and by the right of the Sacred House and its builder.

segments.transliteration: Ya sami'a kulli sawtin,
segments.translation: O Hearer of every sound,

segments.transliteration: Ya jami'a kulli fawtin,
segments.translation: O Gatherer of all that is lost,

segments.transliteration: Ya bari'a al-nufusi ba'da al-mawti,
segments.translation: O Creator of souls after death,

segments.arabic: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ.
segments.transliteration: Salli 'ala Muhammad wa ahli baytihi,
segments.translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and his family.

segments.arabic: وَ آتِنَا وَ جَمِيعَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ،
segments.transliteration: Wa atina wa jami'a al-mu'minina wa al-mu'minat,
segments.translation: And grant us and all believing men and women,

segments.transliteration: Fi mashariqi al-ardi wa magharibaha,
segments.translation: across the East and the West of the earth,

segments.transliteration: Farajan min 'indika 'ajilan,
segments.translation: relief from You, swiftly,

segments.arabic: بِشَهَادَةِ أَن لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ.
segments.transliteration: Bi shahadati an la ilaha illa Allah,
segments.translation: with the testimony that there is no god but Allah.

segments.transliteration: Wa anna Muhammadan 'abduka wa rasuluka,
segments.translation: and that Muhammad is Your servant and messenger,

segments.transliteration: Salla Allahu 'alayhi wa alihi,
segments.translation: may Allah send blessings upon him and his family,

segments.transliteration: Wa 'ala dhurriyyatihi al-tayyibina al-tahirin,
segments.translation: and upon his pure and righteous offspring,

segments.transliteration: Wa sallama tasliman kathiran,
segments.translation: and grant abundant peace and salutations.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِيَّاكَ أَرْجُو وَ إِيَّاكَ ادْعُو،
segments.transliteration: Allahumma iyaka arju wa iyaka ad'u,
segments.translation: O Allah, in You I hope and to You I pray,

segments.transliteration: Faballighni amali wa aslih 'amali,
segments.translation: so fulfill my aspirations and rectify my deeds.

segments.arabic: اَلَّهُمَّ صَلّ عَلىٰ فَاطِمَةَ وَ اَبِيْهَا وَ بَعْلِهَا وَ بَنِيْهَا وَ سِرِِّ الْمُسْتَوْدِعِ فِيْهَا بِعَدَدِ مَا اَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ
segments.transliteration: ma Salle al Fatima wa abeeha wa baleha wa baneeha wa sirril mustaudaeh fiha beadada maa ahaata be
segments.translation: Oh Allah send blessings on Fatima and her father, her husband and her sons, and by the secret installed in her (S)) which only is in YOUR know

segments.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمٰوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِیْمِ.
segments.transliteration: allaahumma rabbas samaawaatis sab-eâ wa rabbal aârshil aâzeeme.
segments.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the great Throne.

segments.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، مُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَ الْاِنْجِيْلِ وَ الْفُرْقَانِ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَ النَّوٰی، اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَیْءٍ اَنْتَ اٰخِذٌ بِنَاصِیَتِہٖ.
segments.transliteration: rabbanaa wa rabba kulle shayin, munzelat tawraate wal injeele wal furqaane, faaleqal habbe wan nawaa, a-oâozo beka min kulle shay-in anta aakhezun be-naaseyatehi.
segments.translation: O our Lord and the Lord of everything, revealer of the Taurat, Injeel and Furqan, splitter of the seed and grain. I seek your refuge from everything, whose control is in your hands.

segments.arabic: اَنْتَ الْاَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَ اَنْتَ الْاٰخِرُ فَلَیْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَیْءٌ وَ اَنْتَ الظَّاہِرُ فَلَیْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَیْءٌ، وَ اَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَیْسَ دُوْنَكَ شَیْءٌ اِقْضِ عَنِّی الدَّیْنَ، وَ اَغْنِنِیْ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ.
segments.transliteration: antal awwalo falaysa qablaka shay-un, wa antal aakhero fa-laysa baâdaka shay-un wa antaz zaahero fa-laysa fawqaka shay-un, wa antal baateno fa-laysa doonaka shay-un iqze aânneyad dayna, wa aghnenee menal faqre.
segments.translation: You are the first, there is nothing before You; and You are the last and there is nothing after You. You are the apparent and there is nothing above You; and You are the concealed and there is nothing nearer than You, facilitate the repayment of my debt and make me needless from poverty.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ بِحَقِّ الْعَرْشِ وَ مَنْ عَلَاهُ، وَ بِحَقِّ الْوَحْيِ وَ مَنْ اَوْحَاهُ، وَ بِحَقِّ النَّبِيِّ وَ مَنْ نَبَّاَهُ، وَ بِحَقِّ الْبَيْتِ وَ مَنْ بَنَاهُ، يَا سَامِعَ كُلِّ صَوْتٍ، يَا جَامِعَ كُلِّ فَوْتٍ، يَا بَارِءَ النُّفُوْسِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ، صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اَهْلِ بَيْتِهٖ وَ اٰتِنَا وَ جَمِيْعَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ فِيْ مَشَارِقِ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَغَارِبِهَا فَرَجًا مِنْ عِنْدِكَ عَاجِلًا بِشَهَادَةِ اَنْ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ، وَ اَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَ رَسُوْلُكَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِهٖ، وَ عَلٰى ذُرِّيَّتِهِ الطَّيِّبِيْنَ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ، وَ سَلَّمَ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرًا.
segments.transliteration: allaahumma be-haqqil aârshe wa man aâlaaho, wa be-haqqil wahye wa man awhaaho, wa be-haqqin nabiyye wa man nabbaaho, wa be-haqqil bayte wa man nabaaho, yaa saame-aâ kulle sawtin, yaa jaame-aâ kulle fawtin, yaa baare-an nofoose baâdal mawte, salle aâlaa mohammadin wa ahle baytehi wa aatenaa wa jamee-aâl moameneena wal moamenaate fee mashaareqil arze wa maghaarebehaa farajan min iândeka aâajelan be-shahaadate an laa elaaha illal laaho, wa anna mohammadan aâbdoka wa rasooloka sallal laaho aâlayhe wa aalehi, wa aâlaa zurriyyatehit tayyebeenat taahereena, wa sallama tasleeman kaseeran.
segments.translation: O God, I adjure You by the right of the Arsh and the one, who raised it, and by the right of revelation and by one, who sent; and by the right of the Prophet and one, who made him a prophet; and by the right of Kaaba and one, who made it. O one, who listens to every voice. O one, who gathers all that are lost. O one, who revives the souls after death, bless Muhammad and his Ahle Bayt and grant from your side to me and the believer men and women of the east and the west of the world immediate tranquility and peace. I adjure by the right of âthere is no god, except Allah and Muhammad is the messenger of Allahâ. May Allah have mercy on Muhammad and his purified progeny and convey my salutation to them in excess.

segments.arabic: - اَللّٰهُمَّ وَ اَعْدَائِيْ وَ مَنْ كَادَنِيْ بِسُوءٍ اِنْ اَتَوْا بَرًّا فَجَبِّنْ شَجِيْعَهُمْ...
segments.transliteration: - allaahumma wa a-aâdaa-ee wa man kaadanee be-soo-in in ataw barran fa-jabbin sha-jee-aâhumâ¦
segments.translation: - O God, if my enemies and those, who deceive me, if they intend to cause distress, weaken the strength of their heartâ¦[1]

segments.arabic: - اَللّٰهُمَّ اكْفِنِيْ حَسَدَ الْحَاسِدِيْنَ، وَ بَغْيَ الْبَاغِيْنَ، وَ كَيْدَ الْكَافِرِيْنَ‏...
segments.transliteration: - allaahummak fenee hasadal haasedeena, wa baghyal baagheena, wa kaydal kaafereenaâ¦
segments.translation: - O Allah, suffice me against the envy of the envious and the tyranny of the tyrants and the machination of the disbelieversâ¦[2]

segments.arabic: - اَللّٰهُمَّ احْرُسْنَا بِعَيْنِكَ الَّتِيْ لَا تَنَامُ، وَ رُكْنِكَ الَّذِي لَا يُرَامُ...
segments.transliteration: - allaahummah rusnaa be-aâynekal latee laa tanaamo, wa ruknekal lazee laa yoraamoâ¦
segments.translation: - O God, protect us through the eyes that never sleep and through that support no one can reachâ¦[3]

segments.arabic: يَا عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَ السَّرَائِرِ، يَا مُطَاعُ يَا عَلِيْمُ، يَا اَللهُ يَا اَللهُ يَا اَللهُ يَا هَازِمَ الْاَحْزَابِ لِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، يَا كَائِدَ فِرْعَوْنَ لِمُوْسٰى، يَا مُنْجِيَ عِيْسٰى مِنْ اَيْدِي الظَّلَمَةِ، يَا مُخَلِّصَ قَوْمِ نُوْحٍ مِنَ الْغَرَقِ، يَا رَاحِمَ عَبْدِهٖ يَعْقُوْبَ يَا كَاشِفَ ضُرِّ اَيُّوْبَ، يَا مُنْجِيَ ذِي النُّوْنِ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ، يَا فَاعِلَ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ، يَا هَادِيًا اِلٰى كُلِّ خَيْرٍ، يَا دَالًّا عَلٰى كُلِّ خَيْرٍ، يَا اٰمِرًا بِكُلِّ خَيْرٍ، يَا خَالِقَ الْخَيْرِ، وَ يَا اَهْلَ الْخَيْرِ، اَنْتَ اللهُ رَغِبْتُ اِلَيْكَ فِيْمَا قَدْ عَلِمْتَ وَ اَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوْبِ، اَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ...
segments.transliteration: yaa aâalemal ghaybe was saraa-ere, yaa motaa-oâ yaa aâleemo, yaa allaaho yaa allaaho yaa allaaho yaa haazemal ahzaabe le-mohammadin sallal laaho aâlayhe wa aalehi, yaa kaa-eda fir-aâwna le-moosaa, yaa munjeya eâesaa min aydiz zalamate, yaa mokhallesa qawme noohin menal gharaqe, yaa raahema a'bdeâi yaâqooba yaa kaashefa zurre ayyooba, yaa munjeya zeen noone menaz zolomaate, yaa faa-eâla kulle khayrin, yaa haadeyan elaa kulle khayrin, yaa daal-lan aâlaa kulle khayrin, yaa aameran be-kulle khayrin, yaa khaaleqal khayre, wa yaa ahlal khayre, antal laaho ra-ghibto elayka feemaa qad aâlimta wa anta aâllaamul ghoyoobe, as-aloka an tosalleya aâlaa mohammadin wa aale mohammadinâ¦
segments.translation: O knower of the unseen and the secrets, O one, worthy of obedience and the most knowing, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O one, who defeated all the parties for Muhammad (s.a.w.a.), O one, who took revenge of Musa from Firon. O one, who saved Isa from the oppressors. O One, who saved the people of Nuh from drowning. O one, who had mercy on His servant, Yaqub. O one, who dispelled the troubles of Ayyub. O one, who gave relief to Yunus from the darknesses. O the doer of every good. O the guide to every good. O one, who shows the way to every good. O, one who commands every good. O creator of every good. O owner of all the good. You are that Allah, towards whom I have turned in the issues that You know well. As You are the knower of all the unseen. I beseech You to send mercy on Muhammad and progeny of Muhammadâ¦

segments.transliteration: Ya mawlati Fatimah Agithni
segments.translation: O you who are safe from everything and every thing is afraid of you, cautious, I ask you by your security from everything and the fear of everything from you, to send blessings upon Muhammad and To give me security for myself, my family, my money, and my children, so that I will not fear anyone or be wary of anything at all. You are powerful over all things.

segments.transliteration: Allahumma Salle ala Mohammed wa Aalehi
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: يا آمِناً مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْى ءٍ وَ كُلُّ شَيْى ءٍ مِنْكَ خآئِفٌ حَذِرٌ اَسْئَلُكَ بِاَمْنِكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَ خَوْفِ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مِنْكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّىَ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اَنْ تُعْطِيَنى اَماناً لِنَفْسى وَ اَهْلى وَ مالى وَ وَلَدى حَتّى لا اَخافَ اَحَداً وَ لا اَحْذَرَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ اَبَدَاً اِنَّكَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْى ءٍ قَديرٌ
segments.transliteration: Be haqqe Fatima wa abeeha wa baleha wa baneeha wa sirril mustaudaeh fiha
segments.translation: Fatima and her father, her husband and her sons, and by the secret installed in her (sa)

segments.transliteration: An tusslle `ala Muhammadin wa ali Muhammad
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: بِ حَقِّ فَاطِمَةَ وَ اَبِيْهَا وَ بَعْلِهَا وَ بَنِيْهَا وَ سِرِِّ الْمُسْتَوْدِعِ فِيْهَا
segments.transliteration:
Wa an tafal be anta ahlo 
Wa la tafalbe ma Ana ahlo
segments.translation: Please act as per your stature and do not act based on what I deserve

segments.arabic: اَنْ تُصَلِّ علَىٰ مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد

وَ اَنْ تَفْعَل بِىْ اَنْتَ اَهْلُهُ
وَلاَ تَفْعَلْ بِىْ مَا اَنَا اَهْلُهُ
